title: On the Behavioral Traits of LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.32776v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Users increasingly describe different AI agents as distinct colleagues to work with. AI personality research aims to quantify such impressions by attributing human- like "traits" to agents. However, existing measures fall short: models' self-reports (S-data) diverge from their actual behavior, while informant ratings from LLM judges (I-data) are costly to scale and cover few everyday scenarios. In this paper, we propose A-B-D to infer traits bottom-up from behavioral data (B-data), namely how agents act on their environment and communicate with users, as recorded in existing trajectories. From 345,667 real-world trajectories spanning 80 models, 12 tasks, and 50 harnesses, we extract 318 candidate features that capture both the actions an agent takes at each step (functional) and the language accompanying them (linguistic). We retain only features that show instance-level stability, cross-task consistency, and model discriminability.

translated_title: 论大语言模型智能体的行为特质
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.32776v2 公告类型：替换。摘要：用户越来越多地将不同的AI智能体描述为各具特点的共事同事。AI人格研究旨在通过赋予智能体类似人类的“特质”来量化这种印象。然而，现有的测量方法存在不足：模型的自我报告（S-data）与其真实行为不一致，而来自LLM评判者的他人评分（I-data）成本高昂、难以规模化，且覆盖的日常场景有限。在本文中，我们提出A-B-D方法，从行为数据（B-data）中自下而上地推断特质，即智能体如何作用于环境并与用户交流，这些信息记录在现有的轨迹数据中。从涵盖80个模型、12个任务和50个执行框架的345,667条真实世界轨迹中，我们提取了318个候选特征，这些特征既捕捉了智能体在每一步采取的行动（功能性），也捕捉了伴随行动的语言表达（语言性）。我们仅保留了那些展现出实例级稳定性、跨任务一致性和模型区分性的特征。
tldr: 提出A-B-D方法，从345,667条真实世界轨迹中自下而上提取行为特征，基于智能体的实际行为（而非自我报告或LLM评分）来推断其稳定的人格特质。
en_tdlr: Proposes A-B-D, a bottom-up approach that infers stable personality-like traits of LLM agents from behavioral data, extracting 318 candidate features from 345,667 real-world trajectories spanning 80 models, 12 tasks, and 50 harnesses.
